info.longName: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight Real Estate ETF

funds_data.description: The index, which is composed of securities of all companies included in the S&P 500® Index that are classified as members of the real estate sector, as defined according to the GICS. The manger has adopted a policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the components of the index and in derivatives and other investments that have economic characteristics similar to the components of the index.
